name: exchange-mcp
description: Read and search mail, calendar and the company directory of an on-premises Exchange server, directly over EWS.
long_description: Runs on your computer and talks straight to your own Exchange Server 2016 / 2019 / SE over EWS, with no relay service in between. Mail search, full emails and attachments, drafts and reply drafts, calendar, colleagues' free/busy and directory lookup. Sending stays off unless you turn it on.

ews_url.title: EWS address
ews_url.description: Your OWA address with /EWS/Exchange.asmx instead of /owa, e.g. https://mail.company.com/EWS/Exchange.asmx

username.title: Username (optional)
username.description: Only if login fails with the email address: DOMAIN\user

password.title: Password
password.description: Your Exchange/Windows password. Stored by Claude Desktop in the system's secure storage.

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: Lets Claude send email and meeting invitations. When off, it can only save drafts.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save a new email in Drafts

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Calendar events in a date range

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event with attendees and agenda

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Colleagues' free/busy and common free slots

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Add a calendar entry or meeting

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email (only when sending is allowed)

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send a saved draft (only when sending is allowed)
